legend: PMP is getting a warrior. He is practicing a lot, but the results are not acceptable yet. This time instead of programming contests, he decided to compete in a car racing to increase the spirit of victory. He decides to choose a competition that also exhibits algorithmic features.

AlgoRace is a special league of car racing where different teams compete in a country of n cities. Cities are numbered 1 through n. Every two distinct cities in the country are connected with one bidirectional road. Each competing team should introduce one driver and a set of cars.

The competition is held in r rounds. In i-th round, drivers will start at city si and finish at city ti. Drivers are allowed to change their cars at most ki times. Changing cars can take place in any city in no time. One car can be used multiple times in one round, but total number of changes should not exceed ki. Drivers can freely choose their path to destination.
PMP has prepared m type of purpose-built cars. Beside for PMP’s driving skills, depending on properties of the car and the road, a car traverses each road in each direction in different times.

PMP Warriors wants to devise best strategies of choosing car and roads in each round to maximize the chance of winning the cup. For each round they want to find the minimum time required to finish it.
input: The first line contains three space-separated integers n, m, r (2 ≤ n ≤ 60, 1 ≤ m ≤ 60, 1 ≤ r ≤ 105) — the number of cities, the number of different types of cars and the number of rounds in the competition, correspondingly.

Next m sets of n × n matrices of integers between 0 to 106 (inclusive) will follow — describing the time one car requires to traverse different roads. The k-th integer in j-th line of the i-th set is the time that i-th car requires to traverse the road from j-th city to k-th city. These matrices are not necessarily symmetric, but their diagonal is always zero.

Next r lines contain description of the rounds. The i-th of these lines contains space-separated integers si, ti, ki (1 ≤ si, ti ≤ n, si ≠ ti, 0 ≤ ki ≤ 1000) — the number of starting city, finishing city and the number of possible car changes in i-th round, correspondingly.
output: For each round you should print the minimum required time to complete the round in a single line.
note: In the first sample, in all rounds PMP goes from city #1 to city #2, then city #3 and finally city #4. But the sequences of types of the cars he uses are (1, 2, 1) in the first round and (1, 2, 2) in the second round. In the third round, although he can change his car three times, he uses the same strategy as the first round which only needs two car changes.

legend.ai: PMP 正在成为一名勇士。他进行了大量训练，但目前取得的成绩仍不尽如人意。这一次，他没有参加编程竞赛，而是决定参加赛车比赛，以增强胜利的信念。他决定选择一项同样具有算法特色的比赛。
AlgoRace 是一个特殊的赛车联赛，不同队伍在一个拥有 n 座城市的国家中展开竞争。城市编号为 1 至 n。该国任意两个不同的城市之间都有一条双向道路相连。每支参赛队伍都应派出一名车手和一组汽车。
比赛分为 r 轮。在第 i 轮中，车手从城市 \(s_i\) 出发，在城市 \(t_i\) 结束。车手最多可以换车 \(k_i\) 次。换车可以在任意城市瞬间完成。一辆汽车在一轮比赛中可以被使用多次，但换车总次数不能超过 \(k_i\)。车手可以自由选择前往终点的路径。
PMP 准备了 m 种特制汽车。除 PMP 的驾驶技术外，根据汽车和道路的属性，汽车沿每条道路的不同方向行驶所需的时间也各不相同。
PMP Warriors 希望制定在每一轮中选择汽车和道路的最佳策略，以最大化赢得奖杯的概率。对于每一轮，他们希望求出完成该轮所需的最短时间。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 n、m、r（2 ≤ n ≤ 60，1 ≤ m ≤ 60，1 ≤ r ≤ 10^5），分别表示城市数量、不同类型汽车的数量以及比赛的轮数。
接下来给出 m 组 n × n 的整数矩阵，矩阵中的整数均在 0 到 10^6（含）之间——描述一辆汽车通过不同道路所需的时间。第 i 组矩阵第 j 行中的第 k 个整数，表示第 i 种汽车从第 j 个城市驶往第 k 个城市所需的时间。这些矩阵不一定对称，但其对角线上的元素始终为 0。
接下来 r 行描述各轮比赛。第 i 行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 si、ti、ki（1 ≤ si, ti ≤ n，si ≠ ti，0 ≤ ki ≤ 1000），分别表示第 i 轮的起始城市、终点城市以及允许更换汽车的次数。

output.ai: 对于每一轮，在单独一行中输出完成该轮所需的最短时间。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，每一轮 PMP 都从城市 #1 前往城市 #2，然后前往城市 #3，最后到达城市 #4。但他在第一轮和第二轮中使用的汽车类型序列分别为 (1, 2, 1) 和 (1, 2, 2)。在第三轮中，尽管他可以更换汽车三次，但他采用了与第一轮相同的策略，而该策略只需要更换两次汽车。
